_note: Default config of StuppFKPPSolver: every parameter. The structural entries (volume paths, grid, snapshots, time step, stopping and solver-behaviour keys) are at the class defaults except the time step (tests/test_config.py checks that); the physical parameters are the MEDIANS of the sensitivity search space fisher_kpp_jax/search_spaces/stupp_fkpp_search_space.json (2026-09-10; the geometric centre of a log-uniform range, the midpoint of a uniform one): white_matter_diffusivity 0.096825 and rho 0.019365 from a front speed of 0.0866 mm/day and a front width of 2.236 mm (D = v lambda / 2, rho = v / (2 lambda)), chemo_kill_rate 2.236e-3, rt_alpha 0.04472, rt_alpha_beta_ratio 8, and the seed at a peak density of 0.8 and a width of sigma = 2.828 x 2.236 = 6.3 mm (gaussian_seed_diffusion_time = sigma^2 / 2 = 19.845, gaussian_seed_mass = 0.8 (4 pi 19.845)^(3/2) = 3150.5, gaussian_seed_scale 1); chemo_decay_rate 9.24 is the search space's fixed value. The Stupp protocol timing is NOT a median: resection_time 100 and the schedule below are the protocol at its original days. Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; the tissue maps are the reference_solves/ maps (182x218x182, 1 mm); the seed is the image center.
_time_step: steps_per_day 12 (dt = 1/12 day) instead of the class default null: null leaves the step to the solver's stability estimate, max(8 D T / dx^2 + 100, 1.1 rho T) steps over the horizon T, whose step grows with T and exceeds one day for slow tumors (14 % of the 2026-09-07 sensitivity sweep, whose runs all used this config). The solver still raises the step count to its estimate where that is stricter (fast diffusion), with a warning; at most one of n_steps, dt and steps_per_day may be set. scripts/sensitivity_analysis.py refuses a base config with all three null.
_volumes: resection_cavity ({"segmentation": <NIfTI path>, "label": <int>}) and rt_dose (Gy, TOTAL over all fractions) are null: no example segmentation and dose map ship with the repository yet, so this config does not run until they are given.
_clock: Times are days: t=0 is the tumor seed, the simulated growth before surgery is resection_time, the total simulated time is resection_time + time_after_resection.
_schedule: seed (day 0) --> resection (day 100) --> recovery (days 100-114) --> radiotherapy: 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks (days 114-153, Monday = day 114); concomitant TMZ 75 mg/m^2 daily INCLUDING weekends over the same 6 weeks (days 114-155, 42 sessions) --> 4-week break --> adjuvant TMZ on days 1-5 of six 28-day cycles starting 4 weeks after the last fraction (day 181): days 181-185, 209-213, 237-241, 265-269, 293-297, 321-325; 150 mg/m^2 in cycle 1, 200 mg/m^2 in cycles 2-6 (72 sessions in total) --> growth to day 360 (35 days after the last dose).
_treatment: chemo_kill_rate (1/day per mg/m^2; 2.236e-3 is the geometric centre of the sensitivity search space's range 5e-4-1e-2, a total log kill kill * dose / decay of 2.15 over the full 8 900 mg/m^2 schedule at chemo_decay_rate 9.24, 1.19 over the sensitivity analysis's truncated 4 900 mg/m^2 schedule; the parametrisation has no literature source, the range is set by the bounds on the log kill, see the search space's _chemo), chemo_decay_rate (1/day; 9.24 is temozolomide's ~1.8 h plasma half-life, Baker et al. 1999, Clin Cancer Res 5:309) and rt_alpha (1/Gy; 0.04472 is the geometric centre of the search space's range 0.01-0.2) are PLACEHOLDERS awaiting review. rt_alpha_beta_ratio is the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio in Gy (rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio in 1/Gy^2 is derived by the solver and is not a config entry); 8 Gy is the midpoint of the search space's 4-12 Gy (the class default is 10 Gy).
